infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: CareCompanion reads your Apple Health data to support your cancer care: date of birth and sex at birth (to personalize lab reference ranges), and — when you opt in — daily steps, heart rate, and sleep so caregivers can see how you are doing.
infoPlist.NSHealthClinicalHealthRecordsShareUsageD: CareCompanion reads clinical records from your care team — medications, lab results, conditions, procedures, allergies, vital signs, and immunizations — so it can help you understand and manage your cancer treatment in one place.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: CareCompanion reads your calendar to detect upcoming medical appointments and add them to your care timeline.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: CareCompanion reads your calendar to detect upcoming medical appointments — like clinic visits, doctor follow-ups, and hospital procedures — and adds them to your care timeline.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CareCompanion uses the camera to scan prescription bottles and medical documents so we can add medications, lab results, and appointments to your care record.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CareCompanion accesses your photo library so you can upload prescription labels and medical documents to your care record.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: CareCompanion uses device motion to add subtle parallax effects on the home screen. No motion data is stored or sent off device.
